name: Position
description: Moves an effect relative to the weapon or runtime effect root.

name: Rotation
description: Rotates an effect relative to its local attachment.

name: Scale
description: Changes the overall size of the effect.

name: Hue
description: Shifts the effect's color while preserving the original visual where possible.

name: Luminance
description: Adjusts the perceived brightness of the effect.

name: Energy
description: Controls particle intensity for effects that expose an energy-style control.

name: Lifetime
description: Changes how long emitted particles stay alive.

name: Simulation Speed
description: Changes how quickly supported particle systems simulate.

name: Length
description: Adjusts the longitudinal span of supported effects or Orbital paths.

name: Width
description: Adjusts the lateral width of supported effects.

name: Count
description: Controls how many Orbital visuals are active.

name: Speed
description: Controls movement speed along an Orbital path.

name: Spacing
description: Controls separation between Orbital visuals or followers.

name: Radius
description: Controls the radius of an Orbital path.

name: Cycles
description: Controls path repetition/turning behavior for Orbitals.

name: Drift
description: Adds movement lag or drift instead of perfectly rigid following.

name: Snake
description: Enables the existing snake-style Orbital path behavior.

name: Glue
description: Lets supported Orbitals follow the Orbs motion source.

name: Spin
description: Enables continuous spin on supported Orbital visuals.

name: Spin Speed
description: Controls the speed of the spin modifier.

name: Spectrum
description: Enables the Strands spectrum/rainbow behavior.

name: Spectrum Speed
description: Controls how quickly the Strands spectrum animation changes.

name: Drag
description: Enables the Outer Flames drag behavior.
